embeds.description:
In this video im explaining the Morimens Covenant System so Beginners can have a better understanding of it, together we are going over how to get covenants, how to upgrade them and how to start off as an early game player. Hope you enjoy!

-----------------------------------------------------------

content:
If you mean covenant substats, percentage doesnt matter at all as long as you have a good amount of stats you want.
3 level 8 Aliemus would be 16.6% (max) but would mean nothing if you dont need it
Oh okay

Choose based on the Awakeners preferred Stat /s, for example

- GLotan - Crit Rate > Sigil Yield > Crit Damage > else 

- Mouchette - Crit Rate = Death Resist > Crit Damage > else 

- Vortice - Realm Mastery > Crit Damage > Keyflare Regen > else
Rather than the % of Covenant Completion
